epic.summary: Oxidant SQL parity with Databricks SQL on AWS Glue + Lake Formation
epic.description: Systematically validate Oxidant against the Databricks SQL language manual, close parser/dialect/function gaps, extend Glue catalog DDL, and add Lake Formation fine-grained access control. All AWS interactions use AWS SDK for Rust in-process; AWS CLI is not allowed.

stories.description: Map every section of the Databricks SQL language manual to Oxidant capabilities and record baseline pass/gap/NA counts.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Matrix in docs/databricks-coverage.md; each manual section mapped to pass/gap/NA with baseline counts.

stories.summary: Add Databricks-specific SQL corpus to parity harness
stories.description: Create a new databricks-tests/ corpus (or flag Databricks-relevant Spark tests) covering USING, TBLPROPERTIES, PARTITIONED BY, CLUSTER BY, DISTRIBUTE BY, SORT BY, LATERAL VIEW, PIVOT, UNPIVOT, MATCH_RECOGNIZE, QUALIFY, COPY INTO, MERGE INTO, Delta Lake SQL, and Lake Formation GRANT/REVOKE patterns.
stories.acceptance_criteria: New databricks-tests/ inputs + goldens; harness runs them; skipped files recorded with reason.

stories.description: Stand up the staged oxidant-sql::dialect::lower pipeline: string prefilter registry, AST intercept registry, and output naming pass.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Registry shell + migrate strip_temporary_view + AST intercept + output naming pass.

stories.description: Register trivial Spark-to-DataFusion function aliases that are semantically identical.
stories.acceptance_criteria: starts_with/ends_with, var_samp, length, approx_distinct, bool_or/bool_and, signum, pow, ucase/lcase/char aliases pass their golden blocks.

stories.description: Implement the most-used missing scalar functions from the function-missing parity bucket.
stories.acceptance_criteria: split, mask, to_char/to_varchar/to_number, format_string, typeof, elt, bit_count, size/array_size, sort_array, map_contains_key, parse_url, url_encode/decode pass their golden blocks.

stories.summary: Implement CREATE TABLE … USING <format> for Glue/local catalog
stories.description: Implement real CREATE TABLE … USING <format> support lowered to the catalog-backed create path, not a lossy rewrite.
stories.acceptance_criteria: CREATE TABLE … USING with LOCATION/PARTITIONED BY/CLUSTER BY/TBLPROPERTIES; CREATE TABLE LIKE; Hive STORED AS; INSERT OVERWRITE (table + DIRECTORY); LOAD DATA; golden blocks pass.

stories.summary: Implement USE CATALOG / USE DATABASE / USE SCHEMA
stories.description: Implement USE statements via AST intercept so current catalog/namespace is set correctly.
stories.acceptance_criteria: AST intercept sets current catalog/namespace; handles quoting, comments, semicolons; rejects invalid catalogs as Spark does.

stories.description: Implement Spark LIKE ANY / LIKE ALL expression syntax.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Rewritten to OR/AND chain at AST level; golden blocks pass.

stories.description: Implement PIVOT and UNPIVOT relational operators.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Requires child-schema resolution; emits correct LogicalPlan; golden blocks pass.

stories.description: Implement SHOW DATABASES/TABLES/COLUMNS/TBLPROPERTIES and DESCRIBE TABLE/QUERY/CREATE TABLE against catalog metadata.
stories.acceptance_criteria: SHOW DATABASES IN glue, SHOW TABLES IN glue.db, DESCRIBE TABLE glue.db.t, SHOW CREATE TABLE return catalog metadata directly.

stories.description: Implement a plan-level output-naming pass so DataFusion result headers match Spark's Expression.sql algorithm.
stories.acceptance_criteria: schema-only bucket reduced by matching Spark Expression.sql headers for common expressions.

stories.summary: Extend Glue catalog DDL: ALTER/DROP/CREATE DATABASE/REPAIR
stories.description: Extend oxidant-catalog-glue to support full DDL lifecycle using aws-sdk-glue in-process.
stories.acceptance_criteria: ALTER TABLE, DROP TABLE/DATABASE with IF EXISTS/CASCADE, CREATE DATABASE/SCHEMA, CREATE CATALOG, ALTER VIEW, COMMENT ON, TRUNCATE TABLE, REFRESH, REPAIR TABLE/MSCK REPAIR TABLE, SHOW PARTITIONS work; no AWS CLI; integration tests with stub server.

stories.summary: Glue column statistics via ANALYZE TABLE
stories.description: Implement ANALYZE TABLE … COMPUTE STATISTICS for Glue tables using aws-sdk-glue.
stories.acceptance_criteria: ANALYZE TABLE glue.db.t COMPUTE STATISTICS persists and reads column stats via Glue SDK.

stories.description: Create a new crate that resolves Lake Formation effective permissions per table using aws-sdk-lakeformation.
stories.acceptance_criteria: New crate using aws-sdk-lakeformation; resolves effective permissions per table; unit tests with stub server.

stories.summary: Apply Lake Formation row filters and column masks to scans
stories.description: Apply Lake Formation row filters and column masks by rewriting table scan plans in DataFusion.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Plan rewrite injects filters/masks from OXIDANT-DBR-014; honors AccessDenied; integration tests pass.

stories.description: Support Lake Formation cross-account shared catalogs via resource links and permissions.
stories.acceptance_criteria: GetResourceLinks, ListPermissions support; shared Glue tables resolve through resource links.

stories.summary: Delta Lake SQL on Glue: CONVERT/VACUUM/OPTIMIZE/RESTORE
stories.description: Implement Delta Lake maintenance statements for Glue-registered Delta tables.
stories.acceptance_criteria: CONVERT TO DELTA, DESCRIBE HISTORY, DESCRIBE DETAIL, OPTIMIZE, VACUUM, RESTORE, CREATE TABLE … CLONE, CREATE BLOOMFILTER INDEX, GENERATE symlink manifest, FSCK REPAIR TABLE work on Glue-registered tables; stubs + S3 integration tests.

stories.description: Implement Delta DML for Glue-registered Delta tables.
stories.acceptance_criteria: MERGE INTO, UPDATE, DELETE FROM execute and update Glue table metadata as needed.

stories.description: Add a CI job that runs the Databricks parity corpus and fails on regression.
stories.acceptance_criteria: New GitHub Actions job runs Databricks corpus and fails on regression; baseline committed.

stories.summary: Document Glue + Lake Formation SQL support
stories.description: Document supported Databricks SQL on Glue and Lake Formation.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Update catalogs-glue.md, add catalogs-lakeformation.md, add Databricks parity section to README.
